surface.rule: An absolute HTTP(S) URL with a host names a page or repository surface; a label alone is only a name.

version.rule: A nonempty dedicated release, tag or dated-policy value carries the version; text in the URL or label only names it in text.

date.rule: A valid YYYY-MM-DD calendar date on the evidence entry carries the date; a date in its label is named in text, while record-level last_verified is not an entry date.

scope.rule: A nonempty dedicated description of exact reviewed material carries scope; a label naming a document type is named-in-text, but a generic project or repository name is absent. supports maps claims, not reviewed material.

missing_record_rule: Refuse an identifier absent from the committed resource catalogue.

unmeasurable_routes.reason: The audit reads the evidence entry but does not open the linked page, so it cannot verify the page's content.
A moving URL without an entry-level release or tag does not identify the exact revision reviewed.
Catalogue fields do not record the completeness of a human review.
A reference and a scope note do not determine the legal permission for a particular use.

excluded_by_design: Any claim that a linked page says what its entry says it says
Any legal reading of what a licence permits
Any judgement about whether a review was thorough
